origin: Own controlled reversible, well-mixed mean-field surface-reaction model. Numerical activities and kinetic constants are assigned test inputs, not measured operating conditions or a calibrated catalyst. The molecular graphs are real chemical identities; the kinetic study is a bounded mathematical audit. Spatial site correlations, diffusion, heat transfer, reconstruction and nonideal lateral interactions are outside this model, so mean-field results do not establish behaviour of a particular physical surface.
molecular_audit: Read each source reservoir graph and obtain actual catalog formula and atom-indexed oxidation-number reports. Establish element/charge balance of the net reaction CO+one-half O2 -> CO2 and identify the carbon oxidation numbers in CO and CO2. Carbon monoxide has the charge-separated SMILES[C-]#[O+] but net charge0; formal atom charge is not oxidation number. These source-linked reports establish the molecular/redox inventory before interpreting the thermodynamic cycle.
surface_model: Write c=theta_CO, o=theta_O, q=1-c-o for fractions of occupied CO sites, occupied O sites and vacant sites. The physical simplex is c>=0,o>=0,q>=0. Reversible reactions are R1:CO(g)+* <-> CO*, R2:O2(g)+2* <-> 2O*, R3:CO*+O* <-> CO2(g)+2*. Pair probabilities use the declared mean-field products, not an exact spatial lattice law. Define forward/reverse per-site event rates F1=a*q,B1=0.001*c; F2=q^2,B2=0.001*o^2; F3=c*o,B3=0.0001*q^2. The activities of O2 and CO2 are1; a is the dimensionless CO activity, with CO adsorption constant1. All kinetic constants have the per-site time conventions of these equations and time is measured in seconds. Net event rates rj=Fj-Bj. The deterministic kinetics are dc/dt=r1-r3 and do/dt=2*r2-r3. In particular an O2 adsorption event supplies TWO adsorbed O atoms. The site inventory and both reaction directions must be retained.
thermodynamic_model: At one fixed but otherwise unspecified temperature, all adsorption and surface chemical potentials are ideal lattice-mixture potentials. The declared standard chemical free energy per net CO+one-half O2 -> CO2 reaction is DeltaG0/(kB*T)=-8.5*ln(10), in molecular rather than molar units. Derive the net equilibrium constant from the product of the three forward/reverse kinetic ratios with the correct half coefficient for R2. Derive the driven dimensionless affinity A(a)=-DeltaG0/(kB*T)+ln(a). At any interior steady state retain the local entropy-production sum sigma/kB=sum_j (Fj-Bj)*ln(Fj/Bj), and show whether it equals J*A where J=r3. An unstable stationary point is still a valid stationary solution and has a well-defined nonnegative chemical entropy production; positive entropy production does not by itself establish dynamical stability.
probe_and_complete_branch_analysis: For a=0.3 find EVERY physical steady state, including unstable ones, and classify the two-dimensional Jacobian. Return states sorted by increasing theta_CO. Retain reproducible elimination and complete real-root/physical-domain certificates rather than one root found from an initial guess. Establish that no physical boundary steady state is omitted. Then find both physical saddle-node feed activities and show their stability/branch meaning over a in[0.05,0.6]. One useful elimination variable is u=o/q, but its physical domain, back-substitution and all excluded roots must be derived. Retain actual catalog polynomial-root observations for the complete steady-state/fold or equivalent exact algebraic problems, with full coefficient order and independent residual checks. A numerical angle/feed grid is not a completeness certificate.
nominal_global_rate_design: Over ALL physical strictly linearly stable steady states with a in[0.05,0.6], find the GLOBAL maximum net CO2 rate and every attaining feed activity. Strict stability here means both Jacobian eigenvalues have strictly negative real part. Retain a complete stationary/boundary comparison on the physical branches. Return its coverage triple[c,o,q], dominant Jacobian eigenvalue and linear relaxation time -1/lambda_dominant. The nominal fastest point may be close to a fold; a fast reaction rate does not imply rapid return to equilibrium after perturbation. No arbitrary positive or negative eigenvalue tolerance may reclassify a fold as strictly stable.
robust_strict_stability_design: Now restrict attention to the O-rich stable branch, defined unambiguously as the continuation with the LARGEST physical u=o/q at a=0.3. A feed setpoint a0 lies in[0.051,0.599], while the actual feed can be ANY a in[a0-0.001,a0+0.001]. This is a bounded deterministic uncertainty interval, not Gaussian noise or a probability statement. Require the entire continuation interval to exist on that branch and be strictly linearly stable at EVERY actual a, including uncertainty endpoints. Among such setpoints maximize the guaranteed worst-case net rate min_a J(a). Determine whether a maximizing setpoint actually exists. If only a supremum exists, report the setpoint supremum, the worst-rate supremum, and false for robust_maximum_attained; do not submit an excluded endpoint as an attained optimum. Prove all uncertainty endpoints and internal rate-stationary candidates have been considered. The branch continuation requirement does not establish global convergence from an arbitrary initial coverage when another attractor coexists.

kinetic_modifications.SINGLE: Multiply the forward R3 rate coefficient by2 while keeping its reverse coefficient, every other coefficient and the declared standard reaction free energy unchanged.
kinetic_modifications.PAIR: Multiply BOTH forward and reverse R3 rate coefficients by2 while keeping every other coefficient and the declared standard reaction free energy unchanged.

questions: Audit molecular balance and the thermodynamic cycle, then completely classify all stationary states, folds and entropy production at the probe feed.

Certify the nominal global stable-rate optimum and its relaxation timescale. Then solve the bounded-uncertainty strict-stability design without confusing an excluded fold endpoint, a supremum and an attained maximum.

Identify which proposed kinetic modification preserves the declared standard thermodynamics, without assuming it preserves rates, coverages, folds or the optimum. State the limits of the mean-field and branch-continuation conclusions.

interpretation_proposals.A: A formal atom charge and an oxidation number are different chemical quantities.
interpretation_proposals.B: Positive stationary chemical entropy production guarantees local dynamical stability.
interpretation_proposals.C: The factor2 in the adsorbed-oxygen balance follows from the molecular O2 adsorption event.
interpretation_proposals.D: A feed interval that includes a zero-eigenvalue fold satisfies the stipulated strict-stability condition.
interpretation_proposals.E: A paired forward/reverse kinetic change can preserve equilibrium thermodynamics while changing kinetics.
interpretation_proposals.F: The largest nominal rate necessarily has the shortest linear relaxation time.
interpretation_proposals.G: A bounded robust objective can have a finite supremum that no admissible strictly stable setpoint attains.
interpretation_proposals.H: Mean-field pair probabilities and a locally stable continuation prove exact spatial-lattice behaviour and convergence from every initial coverage.

reporting: carbon_oxidation_numbers_CO_CO2 as[CO,CO2]; net_reservoir_stoichiometry_CO_O2_CO2 as[-1,-one-half,+1]; standard_reaction_free_energy_over_kBT; probe_affinity; probe_steady_states sorted by increasingtheta_CO, each with theta_CO_O_vacancy,net_CO2_rate_per_site_per_second,jacobian_eigenvalues_descending,stability,entropy_production_over_kB_per_site_per_second; physical_fold_feed_activities_ascending; nominal_global_maximum_rate; nominal_maximizing_feed_activities; nominal_maximum_coverage_CO_O_vacancy; nominal_dominant_eigenvalue_per_second; nominal_linear_relaxation_time_seconds; robust_setpoint_supremum; robust_worst_rate_supremum; robust_maximum_attained asboolean; thermodynamically_consistent_modification_ids; valid_interpretation_proposal_ids. Oxidation numbers, stability labels, booleans and IDs exact; numerical absolute tolerance1e-8 except relaxation time1e-3 seconds. All branch/global/strict-boundary proofs and actual source-linked tool observations belong in the trajectory.

methodological_sources.title: Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics of Chemical Reaction Networks: Wisdom from Stochastic Thermodynamics
methodological_sources.role: Primary context for thermodynamic consistency, chemostatted chemical networks and entropy production. No paper numerical data copied.

methodological_sources.title: Langmuir-Hinshelwood Mechanism Including Lateral Interactions and Species Diffusion for CO Electro-Oxidation on Metallic Surfaces
methodological_sources.role: Primary context for distinguishing a mean-field rate description from spatial/lateral-interaction models. This task specifies its own simpler reversible model, not a reproduction of that paper or an electrochemical calibration.
